highlights_headline: Upcoming fixes harden mask-filtered glyph rendering and Imagination Vulkan allocation failure handling.
highlights_body: These same-milestone native fixes leave package versions and the managed API unchanged.

bullets.lead: Mask-filtered glyphs handle changing scaler output
bullets.detail: Rendering uses the reloaded glyph's path, format and bounds when successive font-scaler loads differ. Incompatible masks are cleared instead of overflowing sub-byte rows, and clipped embossed masks retain the correct plane strides.

bullets.lead: Imagination Vulkan allocation failures avoid unsafe pool destruction
bullets.detail: Ganesh and Graphite abandon descriptor pools after host or device out-of-memory allocation errors on Imagination drivers, where destroying the pool can trigger a driver failure. Graphite also stops allocating through the abandoned handle; other vendors and errors are unaffected.
